results.title: Hvorfor er du ikke hysterisk?
results.overview: Gunvor has poor impulse control, little self-insight, and an intrusive imagination. For the first time in her life, she has everything in order, so why is she still restless?

results.title: Art Is Dark and Full of Horrors
results.original_title: El arte es oscuro y está lleno de horrores
results.overview: This corrosive satire of the Mexican art world unfolds during a week of ferocious preening, dealing and partying. Star artist Chema rules the scene – but if he falls, every vulture of the art market is ready to swoop in.

results.title: Dwarf Neon Mayfield
results.overview: Intimate and personal moments from rural Kentucky as people struggle to live in the aftermath of a series of historically violent storms, forming a kaleidoscopic impression of country life in America and a singular portrait of ecological collapse within its deepest interior.

results.title: Maya
results.overview: Maya, a physiotherapist in her forties, relocates to the UK after a painful divorce and the loss of her ability to conceive. Living with her caring aunt Ammu, she withdraws emotionally and immerses herself in work. Her routine changes when she begins treating Mahesh, a stubborn sixty-year-old Marathi man recovering from a fracture. Initially hostile, Mahesh agrees to therapy after intervention from his son Siddharth, an optimistic widower and devoted father. As sessions progress, Mahesh's vulnerability emerges, and Maya saves his life twice. A quiet bond forms through shared loneliness, while Maya also feels drawn to Siddharth's warmth.

results.title: GCW: Joey Janela's Spring Break: The Immortal Clusterfuck
results.original_title: GCW: Joey Janela's Spring Break: The Immortal Clusterfuck
results.overview: Joey Janela's Spring Break: The Immortal Clusterfuck 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by Game Changer Wrestling (GCW) that took place on April 18, 2026, in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA. Part of the annual Spring Break series during WrestleMania weekend, the show featured Joey Janela’s signature Immortal Clusterfuck match, a chaotic battle royal-style spectacle bringing together wrestlers and personalities from multiple eras, along with a mix of high-profile independent matches and surprise appearances.

results.title: Shadowbox
results.overview: Maya discovers that her husband – an ex-soldier who is suffering from PTSD - is the prime suspect in a murder investigation. She and her teenage son are forced to go to extremes to keep the family together.

results.title: She Saw Us
results.overview: When four friends discover a cursed two-headed doll in a remote forest, they unleash a vengeful witch who traps them in a place from which no one has ever escaped.

results.title: Heer Sara
results.overview: Two women embark on a rebellious motorcycle odyssey to Pondicherry - one seeking her lost mother, the other racing to uncover the truth behind a wedding. Laughter, chaos and sisterhood spark freedom, self-worth and eco-conscious living.

results.title: New Year's Absolution
results.overview: A New Year’s Eve party turns deadly when a “Kill Someone” resolution sparks paranoia, chaos, and betrayal among friends fighting to survive.

results.title: I Want Him to Want Me
results.original_title: I Want Him to Want Me
results.overview: Determined to find freedom, a lonely wife plans a daring escape from her controlling husband before his suffocating obsession turns deadly.

results.title: El pintor de los milagros
results.overview: After an accident leaves his daughter in a coma, Francisco, a seasoned journalist, tries to rebuild his life by accepting a seemingly minor assignment: uncovering the origins of the ancient mural of the Black Christ, venerated by millions. His search leads him to Santiago, who reveals the untold story of the image's mysterious creator: a young man enslaved in 17th-century Peru, known only as "The Painter." Amid discrimination and suffering, the young man transforms his pain into an extraordinary work: a Black Christ that, over the centuries, would become the most important symbol of faith in our nation and one of the most venerated in the world. As he reconstructs this story of hope, resilience, and redemption, Francisco embarks on a journey that will forever change his understanding of faith and restore his belief that miracles are still possible.

results.title: The Revisionist
results.overview: Elise, a successful novelist, does what so many writers do: she manipulates and transforms the people in her life into the characters she needs for her story. As she blurs the line between fiction and reality, her world descends into secrets, lies, and outright betrayal.

results.title: Waves
results.overview: Nothing is ever really lost, it just changes form.

results.title: Hungry
results.overview: A high school wrestling coach must overcome addictive behavior in ordere to lead his team to a championship.

results.title: Raptor Attack
results.overview: A genetically engineered raptor escapes a secret lab and stalks a family visiting their grandmother's farmhouse, forcing them to fight for survival.

results.title: Family in Nature
results.overview: A modern family embark on a romantic nature trip in an attempt to reconnect. But the peace turns to chaos when their teenage children pose challenges, and the idyllic getaway becomes a comical struggle for survival.

results.title: Artek. Space Adventures
results.overview: The Artek International Children's Center has always been a land of sunshine and loud laughter, but these camps will be special. While an obsessed astronomy professor scours the surrounding area in search of a fallen meteorite for long-awaited glory, inexplicable things begin to happen at the camp. One by one, the most active children turn into "shadows": they lose interest in games, friends, and life, sinking into a frightening apathy. A group of teenagers uncovers an incredible truth: aliens are lurking within the camp, literally draining the children of their joy and happiest memories.

results.title: I Wish You Glory
results.overview: Mitya, a recent high school student, dreams of fame, but has no idea what price he'll have to pay for it. A random car accident, captured on a cell phone camera, makes him a hostage to a frantic media frenzy. He's caught in the maelstrom of political games and becomes a tool for garnering millions of views for his talk show. However, even this isn't enough for the media. Mitya tries to escape this cycle before he's buried in the news feeds.
